title: Draw the network weights and biases
description: You map stored parameters onto a one-hidden-layer diagram.

steps.description: You create diagram axes and place one blue input neuron. hidden_size determines its vertical position and the diagram's height.
You draw a green neuron for each hidden unit and connect it to the input. Connection labels show w1, while nearby neuron labels show b1.

steps.question: Does b2 label every hidden-to-output connection?
steps.answer: Each connection gets a w2 label. b2 appears once beside the output neuron.

steps.description: You add the red output neuron, its incoming weights, and its bias. The displayed diagram formats parameter labels to two decimal places and hides the axes.
